definition.def: You can refer to information as data, especially when it is in the form of facts or statistics that you can analyse. In American English, data is usually a plural noun. In technical or formal British English, data is sometimes a plural noun, but at other times, it is an uncount noun.
examples: The study was based on data from 2,100 women.
...the latest year for which data is available.
To cope with these data, hospitals bought large mainframe computers.

definition.def: Data is information that can be stored and used by a computer program. [computing]
examples: No important data is stored on the devices.
